blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian stressed the need for sustained military modernization and stronger cyberwarfare capabilities, saying the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) should be prepared for evolving security threats. Gatchalian, during the Senate finance subcommittee hearing on the 2027 budget of the Department of National Defense (DND) and its attached agencies on Monday, cited conflicts in the Middle East and Eastern Europe as reminders of the rapidly changing geopolitical landscape. He emphasized the need to acquire equipment that would prepare the country for emerging forms of warfare, including cyberattacks. “The geopolitical situation in our region and around […]...
